services.name: Bass Fishing
services.desc: Experience the thrill of smallmouth bass fishing on the stunning St. Lawrence River, where crystal-clear waters and scenic landscapes create the perfect backdrop for your adventure. Capt. PJ's knowledge of the diverse fishing spots along the river provides anglers the best opportunity to catch trophy-sized bass. With expert tips and local knowledge, you’ll be well-equipped to explore this fishing paradise and create unforgettable memories. Reel in a trophy-sized Northen and you'll experience the fight of your life! Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, this adventure is guaranteed to create memories on the water.
